d: Rotana is looking for an accomplished Director of Sales to join our Global Sales Office in Saudi Arabia, reporting to the Corporate Vice President – Global Sales.

This is a senior commercial role responsible for developing and growing Rotana’s portfolio of key accounts across Corporate, MICE and strategic travel partners, with a strong focus on the Saudi market and its growing influence across regional and international travel.

The successful candidate will combine strong relationships within the Kingdom with strategic commercial thinking, using their network, market knowledge and influence to generate new opportunities, strengthen existing partnerships and drive profitable revenue across Rotana’s portfolio of hotels and resorts.
q: You will be an experienced hospitality or travel sales leader with a strong commercial network and the credibility to engage confidently with senior decision-makers.
Significant senior-level experience in hotel sales, global sales, key account management or business development.
Strong knowledge of the Saudi Arabian corporate, MICE and travel market.
An established network of key corporate and industry relationships within the Kingdom.
Proven success in developing major accounts and delivering sustainable revenue growth.
Strong commercial negotiation and strategic account-management capabilities.
Experience working across multiple hotels, markets or geographic regions.
Strong understanding of hotel pricing, revenue management and distribution principles.
Experience with CRM-driven sales management; knowledge of Thynk would be an advantage.
Excellent presentation, communication and influencing skills.
The ability to work effectively across different cultures, markets and stakeholder groups.
Fluency in Arabic and English is essential.
A high level of integrity, commercial awareness and professional judgement.
r: Develop and execute the sales strategy for key global and Saudi-based accounts, aligned with Rotana’s commercial objectives.
Build and manage senior-level relationships with major corporations, government and semi-government entities, travel partners, procurement leaders and key decision-makers.
Grow revenue and market share across Corporate, MICE and strategic travel segments.
Identify new accounts, partnerships and business opportunities within Saudi Arabia and relevant international source markets.
Lead commercial negotiations covering global agreements, pricing, volume commitments and business terms.
Work closely with Revenue Management and Distribution teams to protect rate integrity, profitability and appropriate pricing strategies.
Partner with Rotana hotels and regional sales teams to convert opportunities and ensure effective execution of global account strategies.
Maintain a deep understanding of account structures, travel programmes, decision-making processes and future business potential.
Represent Rotana at key industry events, trade shows, sales missions, client engagements and roadshows.
Monitor market trends, competitor activity and changing corporate and MICE travel patterns.
Ensure accurate management of accounts, opportunities, activities, contracts and pipelines through Thynk CRM.
Use commercial data and account insights to forecast performance, evaluate opportunities and drive continued account growth.
Act as a senior ambassador for Rotana, ensuring collaborative and transparent relationships between the Global Sales Office, hotels and business partners.

d: Location: Etqan Global Academy (EGA), Doha, Qatar
Nord Anglia Education is looking to recruit a MYP Language & Literature Teacher (English) to join Etqan Global Academy (EGA) in Doha, Qatar.

Etqan Global Academy (EGA) is a newly established IB World School in Doha, Qatar, offering the IB Middle Years Programme (MYP). We are looking for a talented and passionate MYP Language & Literature Teacher to inspire our students to become confident, critical readers, writers and communicators within the IB MYP framework.
We seek an individual to join as MYP Language & Literature Teacher (English) where your focus will be:
Planning and delivering high-quality, concept-driven Language & Literature lessons aligned with the IB MYP curriculum and global contexts
Designing engaging, inquiry-based learning experiences that develop reading, writing, critical thinking and communication skills
Assessing student work using MYP Language & Literature criteria and providing meaningful, constructive feedback
Creating units of inquiry that explore language, literature, global contexts and intercultural perspectives
Embedding ATL skills and a genuine love of reading and language throughout all aspects of teaching
Supporting students' preparation for MYP eAssessment in Language & Literature
Fulfilling Form Tutor responsibilities and contributing to the pastoral life of the school
Contributing positively to the English department and the wider EGA school community
A recognised teaching qualification (PGCE, QTS, B.Ed or equivalent) and a degree in English, Language & Literature or a related subject
Proven experience teaching Language & Literature or English in an IB MYP school
Strong knowledge of the MYP Language & Literature curriculum, assessment criteria and eAssessment
Excellent literacy skills and a genuine passion for language and literature
Ability to design and deliver concept-driven, inquiry-based and differentiated lessons
Effective classroom management and communication skills
A commitment to safeguarding and student wellbeing
IB MYP workshop training in Language & Literature desirable; international school experience desirable

d: MACNA, a wholly Saudi-owned company and a key member of the Al Blagha Group, has been a leader in marine mobility solutions since 1995. Focussing on passenger and cargo transport, we operate a specialised fleet of over 30 vessels.

As the partner of choice in the Kingdom of high-speed passenger ferries and landing craft, we deliver safe, reliable and customer focussed services to all our clients leveraging our history, experience and expertise.

Provide nursing care, first aid and medical support to project shore staff and vessel personnel, including support for the project’s ambulance boats. The role reports directly to the Project QHSE Manager and operates within authorized nursing practice and approved protocols.
q: Valid SCFHS classification as a Nursing Specialist.
Previous healthcare or hospital experience preferred.
r: Patient care: Provide first aid and initial assessments, administer medication within authorization, follow up on treatment, appointments and referrals in coordination with HR and Logistics, and accompany patients to hospitals when needed.

Emergency response and ambulance boats: Respond to medical emergencies, provide CPR and basic life support, accompany transfers and evacuations, check ambulance boat readiness and equipment, and take part in emergency drills.
Monthly vessel inspections: Inspect medical facilities, equipment and supplies on vessels (medicines, expiry dates, oxygen, AEDs) and share findings with the Master and the QHSE Manager.
Crew health checks: Support health check programmes, carry out basic checks, and arrange follow-up where needed.
Facilities and supplies: Keep first-aid areas and any future clinic ready, apply hygiene and infection prevention measures, dispose of clinical waste safely, and maintain inventories.
Health awareness: Support awareness activities (heat stress, hydration, hygiene, communicable diseases), assist with first-aid training, and flag hygiene concerns observed during visits.

Records and follow-up: Keep confidential medical records, report injuries and illnesses, track cases through to closure, assist with MSCOM reports, provide a monthly summary, and hand over properly during leave.
